overview: You wrote the share as thirty-three shillings. You wrote that the coffer was not opened, and that it stands as ruled at twenty pound fifteen. Heminges sends to Kettleby tonight. Monday is as billed. Kemp said tour, and the room did not agree. You did not make a new total.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the share, and did not open the coffer.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Sends tonight. The leaf is yours.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Said tour, and was not agreed with.

parties.name: Ambrose Kettleby
parties.context: The man the message goes to. Not in the house.

assets.name: thirty-three shillings
assets.disposition: Wrote thirty-three beside the old ruling

summary: Wrote thirty-three beside the old ruling
